turns: How do I build credit in Canada? I have nothing
reply: Here's how to build credit from scratch: (1) Open a student or secured credit card with a low limit. A secured card needs a refundable deposit and reports to the credit bureaus like a normal card. (2) Put one small recurring bill on the card (e.g. the phone plan) and set autopay for the full statement balance. (3) Keep the balance under about 30% of the limit at statement time. (4) Never miss a payment; payment history is the largest factor in a credit score. (5) Check your report for free from Equifax and TransUnion Canada once you have a few months of history. General information, not personalised financial advice. HomeBridge is not a licensed adviser.
